summary: Refactored agent-server extension tests to use inline GizmoServerExtension objects instead of importing from removed first-party packages, fixed type-check failures (Type.Object and missing details field), relocated Unity tests to a separate registry workspace, and updated docs/extensions.md to describe the no-built-ins runtime model where extensions arrive through `extensions.web` and de-duplicate by id.
decisions: Inline `svelteExtension`/`unityExtension` definitions are used in agent-server tests rather than importing from `@gizmo/svelte/server` or `@gizmo/unity/server` (those packages were removed).
Tool parameter schemas in registry.test.ts use `Type.Object({})` from `typebox` instead of plain object literals.
Tool `execute` returns must include `details: {}` to satisfy the `AgentToolResult<unknown>` shape.
Unity test files were moved out of `apps/agent-server/tests/unity/` into the `gizmo-registry` workspace (then later targeted for deletion).

First-party packages (`activity`, `git`, `svelte`, `unity`, `unity-tools`, `skill-authoring`) were deleted, and the docs now state there are no built-in extensions — the registry starts empty and web extensions de-duplicate by id.

Web bundles for the editor companion are now read from `dist/web.js` per extension and placed under `~/.pi/agent/extension-web/` (outside Pi's backend auto-discovery) to avoid Pi executing browser code as an extension.
errors: `pnpm check` failed with TS2322 in registry.test.ts because the tool's `execute` return type was missing the required `details` field; resolved by adding `details: {}` to the execute result.

Two test failures after the registry rewrite: `registerWebExtensions > adds loaded extensions alongside the built-in ones` expected 'svelte' but received ['third-party', 'unity'] because the test still assumed a built-in svelte entry, and `AgentStore > discovers projects and keeps per-session transcripts` got `undefined` for `projectStatus.state` (expected 'connected'). These were being investigated at the end of the segment.
